# ADR-3241: AWS s3: Public ACL grant for bucket 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Public ACLs are a leading cause of data leaks.

## Decision

Buckets SHALL NOT apply a public ACL grant for bucket 1 (AWS-s3-1).

## Consequences

Block Public Access is account-enforced.
